items.literal_en: Making sense, first-charged double reward doesn't reset, understood, it's just asking you to spend money... free players are finding it harder to play now
items.meaning_en: The game's reward system for first charges is designed to encourage spending, making it increasingly difficult for non-spending players to enjoy the game

concerns.issue_zh: 首充双倍不重置导致玩家氪金压力增大
concerns.issue_en: First-charged double reward not resetting increases player spending pressure
concerns.quote: 讲道理首充双倍又不重置，懂了，就是要你氪……白嫖党表示越来越难玩了
